_readme: Finance-editable funding sources, merged on top of the FY27 workbook.
Use this when the master workbook lags reality: a partnership starts mid-year, or a partner's funding
has to be split by period before the workbook is reissued. Entries under 'additions' appear in the PRF
Funding Source dropdown for the named site, exactly like a workbook row, and are labelled
'Finance overrides' in the source column so they are easy to review and re-code later.
'site' accepts a site key ('7704|Central High School'), a bare site code ('7704'), or a site name
('Central High School'). When it matches a known site the code, name and region are filled in from the
workbook; otherwise the value is used as the site name as given.
'additions' starts empty on purpose. Period-specific names such as 'Camino Nuevo Summer 26' are real
accounting codes, and inventing them here would put codes into circulation that Finance never approved.
The '_example' block below is documentation only — it is never read. Copy an entry into 'additions'
Changes take effect on the next server start (the workbook and this file are both cached per process).
Set FUNDING_OVERRIDES_PATH to point somewhere else.

_example.notes: Next fiscal year — do not use before 07/01/2027
